## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependency updates, or repository maintenance
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests

## Verification & Quality Gates
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passed (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Linter passed with 0 errors and warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Full test suite passed with coverage (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] CI workflow passes across Node 18, 20, and 22
